label: Job Posting Optimizer
description: Reviews and improves job postings for clarity, inclusion, competitiveness, and alignment with role requirements. Reduces bias and improves candidate quality.

guidedInputs.label: Current job posting (or draft)
guidedInputs.description: Paste your current job posting. The module will review and improve it.

guidedInputs.label: Role context and key success factors
guidedInputs.description: What are the most important things this person must be able to do? What kind of candidate profile typically succeeds in this role?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., The person needs to work independently across multiple client projects simultaneously. Must be comfortable with ambiguity. Team is informal and collaborative but delivery standards are high. Previous hires from Big 4 have worked well.

guidedInputs.label: Target candidate profile
guidedInputs.description: Who is the ideal candidate? Where are they likely to be working now?
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Currently working at a bank, regulator, or consulting firm in a compliance or risk role. 5–8 years of experience. Likely 30–40 years old. We want to attract people who want a more varied and client-facing role than in-house compliance offers.

guidedInputs.label: What should the review focus on?
Posting platform
guidedInputs.description: Different platforms have different conventions and character limits.
